title: Offline ATM authority is bank-issued, bounded and single-use
summary: Offline cash vending is permitted only under a retained bank-issued authority. RESERVED_ALLOWANCE is hold-backed; DELEGATED_STAND_IN is explicit bank risk authority that may later create mandatory settlement after physical cash has left the terminal.
invariants: An ATM-supplied offlineAuthorityId has no authority by itself.
Both modes pass Bouncer, Institutional Policy and Legal Effect before issue.
The bank resolves stored authority and verifies terminal/session/customer/account/currency/rules/amount/sequence/single-use binding rather than trusting client assertions.
Expiry blocks new vending but bounded delayed reconciliation may still settle cash physically dispensed while authority was valid.
A terminal timestamp is evidence, not authority; delayed advice is accepted only inside the bank-issued identity/amount envelope and reconciliation window.
The retained authority topic is authorization/risk evidence, not a balance store; monetary truth remains Ledger SQL.

provenance.claim: Offline authority is bank-issued with RESERVED_ALLOWANCE and DELEGATED_STAND_IN modes.
Bank resolves retained authority; delayed reconciliation remains bounded and terminal time is evidence, not authority.
Offline authority topic is authorization evidence; Ledger SQL remains monetary truth.
